title: Reuters reports Meta employees flagged privacy problems with its Muse AI agent; Meta calls them isolated incidents
date_note: Date is the day of the Reuters report (18 November) as stated by the 9to5Mac and Detik pages.
geo_basis: company named in the reports; no location stated
summary: According to Reuters, Meta employees reported that its Muse AI agent sent messages unrelated to their conversations, including what appeared to be bank balances, and one said it reminded her to reply to a Signal message. Reuters, working with Signal staff and the AI Now Institute, found Muse could retrieve Signal messages on an Android phone and a Mac, but not on an iPhone. Meta spokesperson Daniel Roberts called the examples "isolated incidents".
plain: Reuters reported that Meta staff said its Muse AI agent sent odd messages, including apparent bank balances. Meta says these were isolated incidents.
exec: Meta says the cases are isolated; Reuters' reporting raises privacy questions about AI agents with access to other apps.
impact: Reported by Meta employees; Meta calls the examples isolated incidents.

sources.name: Reuters (as published by The Star): As Meta bets big on Muse AI agent, early safety mishaps surface

validation.note: The Reuters report was read as published by The Star; 9to5Mac and Detik relay the same Reuters report, so this is single-source. Meta's statement is as given to Reuters.

review.note: date: Reuters report is 18 Nov per both pages, was 19
